purpose: Represent a long-lived working chat independently of any individual ChatGPT conversation so it can be reincarnated, self-document, coordinate parallel work and survive transcript loss.

identity.project_id: Human-level umbrella. One project may contain multiple Chat Objects.
identity.chat_object_id: Durable conversational/operational identity that survives any individual ChatGPT conversation.
identity.workstream_id: Durable execution/coordination scope used by Prometeo runtime.
identity.worker_instance_id: Disposable execution incarnation or delegated worker identity.
identity.conversation_id: Optional platform-level source reference when exposed; never required for recovery.

state_pointers.design_board_ref: Architecture, decisions, hypotheses, experiments, future ideas.
state_pointers.rules_ref: Invariants, must-preserve behavior, negative knowledge and prevention rules.
state_pointers.work_board_ref: Prepared jobs, batches, worker runs, returns and consumption/integration state.
state_pointers.shared_graph_ref: Shared capabilities, owners, dependencies, adapters, child workstreams and impacts.
state_pointers.evidence_refs: Important durable refs and optional historical conversation evidence.

reincarnation.transcript_rule: A previous ChatGPT transcript may enrich recovery but must not be required for correct operation.
reincarnation.freshness_rule: Use EPOCH/compiled state to avoid unnecessary global rereads; reload only relevant durable parts that changed.

material_changes_must_persist: new negative knowledge or regression prevention rule
update_law.distillation_rule: Persist distilled operational state, not raw transcript dumps.
update_law.self_documentation: The active incarnation is responsible for keeping the Chat Object sufficiently current that a replacement conversation can continue without reconstructing settled design from scratch.

authority.rule: Chat Object state coordinates understanding and work; it does not override Current, Catalog, Lineage, Human Accepted or Served owners.
authority.candidate_separation: FACT, HUMAN_ACCEPTED and HYPOTHESIS/CANDIDATE remain distinct.

parallelism.job_rule: Delegated work must exist durably before a worker conversation is launched.
parallelism.worker_rule: Workers use independent run/status objects; parent views are derived.
parallelism.integration_rule: Parallel returns are reconciled by the owning parent/steward; no last-writer-wins promotion.
